title: ai-rulez search
description: Output of `ai-rulez search <query> --format json`: the served skills ranked against the query by the ranker find_skill uses (lexical BM25F, or hybrid with an embedding index).

abstained.description: True when [search] vector_min_sim left no skill: nothing is a confident match for the query. Absent otherwise.

score.description: The fused (RRF), BM25F or cosine score, by ranking.

lexical_rank.description: Rank in the lexical candidate list of a hybrid ranking.

vector_rank.description: Rank in the vector candidate list.

vector_sim.description: Cosine similarity of the query and the skill.

stale_vector.description: The skill changed since it was indexed, so it ranked lexically only.

ranking.description: What produced the order; lexical when a requested vector mode degraded.

degraded.description: Why a hybrid or vector search was answered lexically; null otherwise.
